platform: phone (YouTube app on iOS) and web, edited YouTube video

files.speech: speech (en), checked on a 2-min sample from 0 s

description: YouTube's watched-progress overlay on thumbnails is wrong: videos show as fully watched when barely started, and bars change just by scrolling a playlist.
expected_report: In playlists the red progress bar on thumbnails shows wrong values (100% for videos only partly or barely watched); scrolling the playlist alone changes the bars randomly. The author checks API/desktop responses. Expected: progress bars match actual watch progress and do not change when scrolling.
difficulty: Edited video with cuts, talking head, zooms and b-roll; phone recordings inside; long (8 min).
not_repro: an edited video about bugs (vlog or explainer), not a recording of one bug repro; left out of the bug set
